## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] `external/threadx` is unchanged
- [ ] Debug and Release build and pass `ctest` on QEMU
- [ ] `tools/regression.sh all` passes (for port or BSP changes)
- [ ] `python3 tools/trace.py --check` reports no gaps
- [ ] Requirement tags, tests and `docs/` updated where behaviour changes
- [ ] No new MISRA C:2025 findings, or a deviation record is added
